claim: Ho's configuration: 150 hosts; depth, subnets, endpoints, runs not stated; general scenario; end of run a 15 000 s time limit; intervals 50, 100, 200 s.
quote: Finish Time 15000 Total Nodes 150 Static Degrade Factor 2000(ms)
locator: p. 18 printed (PDF p. 19), Table 2; intervals Table 6, p. 22 printed (PDF p. 23); general scenario 'to try to compromise as many hosts as possible', p. 13 printed (PDF p. 14)
issue: Values match, and Ho states no depth, subnets, endpoints or trial count. Two gaps: Ho gives the finish time and intervals without a unit and states the same clock's static degrade factor in ms ('2000(ms)'), so 'seconds' is ours (from the simulator), against Ho's only stated unit; and Ho also varies a 'Network Size' of 100, 150 and 200 at 150 nodes (Table 7), which the column omits.

claim: A learned deployment strategy's attacker is the attacker model its training environment simulates (Ho).
quote: It is used as a platform for the MTD AI model to interact with the adversary. It is also used for collecting results for the evaluation of the model.
issue: Ho trains and evaluates against MTDSimTime's adversary; matches at the claim's scope.

claim: Ho uses MTTC (attacker-side), risk and time since last MTD (defender-side) as MTD effectiveness metrics.
quote: The change of risk per interval(before and after moving target defense deployment) is measured as an indicator of the effectiveness of the MTD deployment.
locator: p. 19 printed (PDF p. 20), Sect. 3.3.2; MTTC and TSLM p. 20 printed (PDF p. 21); evaluation metrics p. 23 printed (PDF p. 24), Sect. 3.4.2
issue: Risk holds. MTTC and time since last MTD are model inputs/reward features in Ho, not evaluation metrics (Ho evaluates on ASR, ROA, APE and Risk only, Sect. 3.4.2), and Ho's MTTC is 'the durations of attack events of SCAN PORT, EXPLOIT VULN, and BRUTE FORCE', not a time to compromise. Time since last MTD as an effectiveness metric is our classification.
fix_text: drop [ho2024] from 'time since last MTD', or move the item out of the effectiveness row

claim: Ho used deployment intervals of 50, 100 and 200 s.
issue: The three values are Ho's, but unitless; Ho's only explicit unit on the simulator clock is ms ('2000(ms)', p. 14 printed). The seconds come from the simulator, not from Ho.

quote: Simulator settings run trials from 0 to 15000 to gather adequate data.
issue: Number is Ho's, unitless; same unit caveat as U0590. The dissertation elsewhere calls Ho's 2 000 ms static degrade factor '2 000 s' (U1027), a mismatch an examiner who reads Ho may ask about.

claim: MTDSim's code was inherited in part from Ho's study.
quote: In this project, this simulator will be extended to include more purposeful deployment and also consider a wide range of MTD techniques.
issue: Ho extended the simulator; whether Ho's code is in this repository's history is a code fact the report cannot carry.
